description:
About the job




About Us

Dymax, part of the Bachmann Chemical & Engineering family of brands is based out of Torrington, Connecticut. Dymax is globally recognized as a pioneer in the development of light-curable adhesives and curing equipment. Today, our expansive portfolio of innovative adhesives, coatings, and maskants are supported by dispense solutions and cutting-edge UV and LED light-curing equipment. Unlike our competitors who supplying standard products, Dymax focuses on the customer experience by tailoring solutions that help customers lower costs, reduce their carbon footprint, improve efficiency, and drive profitability. Our focus on being a customer intimate organization has led us to where we are today: a rapidly expanding force within our industry, an innovative product portfolio, extraordinary employees, and a bright future based on creating quality offerings with a dedication to business growth.

About You

We're seeking a result-focused, innovative, self-driven, and well-qualified individual to join our talented team as our Engagement & Demand Generation MarCom Specialist. You will execute integrated MarCom activities that generate brand awareness, engagement, and leads by developing and deploying content, campaigns, and promotional assets across digital, social, and event channels, applying established messaging and brand guidelines to deliver consistent, accurate, and effective communications for an assigned brand or portfolio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Execute integrated marketing communications activities for an assigned brand or portfolio by developing content and campaign materials aligned with established messaging and marketing direction across digital, social, email, web, and event channels
Create multichannel marketing assets that enable effective customer engagement by drafting, designing, editing, and publishing content, including graphics, videos, written materials, presentations, and promotional collateral for use across campaigns and sales enablement efforts

Apply market and performance insight to improve marketing execution by monitoring campaign results, engagement metrics, and channel performance, and using insights to refine tactics and improve effectiveness within established frameworks
Coordinate marketing communications schedules and content calendars by planning, maintaining, and adjusting editorial schedules that align day-to-day communications activity with campaign timing, business priorities, and channel-specific delivery requirements
Manage external vendors, agencies, and partners to support marketing execution by coordinating inputs, clarifying requirements, reviewing deliverables for accuracy and quality, and ensuring content is delivered on time and aligned with established brand and campaign expectations
Execute events and promotional activities by coordinating event logistics, stakeholders, materials, messaging, and follow-up activities that reinforce brand presence, enable engagement, and capture participation and lead outcomes for reporting and review


Requirements



You should have: 

BS/BA degree in Communications, Marketing, or equivalency
Experience executing integrated marketing communications or digital marketing activities across multiple channels
Working knowledge of MarCom tools and platforms, including social media, content management systems, marketing automation, and analytics tools
Strong writing, editing, and content development capability with attention to detail and brand consistency
Ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently and apply sound judgment within established marketing direction
This role requires strong English communication skills, including the ability to speak, read, and write clearly and effectively.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.




Your New Role:
The Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. He or she will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.




Your Role Accountabilities:




Business Analysis

Collaborate with key business stakeholders to generate business requirements based on use cases/user stories. Prioritize and scope based on business input and ROI. 
Lead collaboration with the global teams to assure incorporation of global requirements for enhancements when prioritized and justified related to regional requirements. Assure no negative impact to global regional workflows.
Collaborate with internal engineering, vendor engineering, internal technical teams and external technical teams to assure vendor and technical designs cover mandatory business requirements.
Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments. 
Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing

Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training

Provide a walk thorough of new functionality including both system functionality and region-specific recommended configuration and workflow. Train the trainer.
Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards

Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

Work independently under minimal supervision.




Qualifications & Experiences:

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent degree/work experience
Experience supporting technology solutions in a Media industry organization
Minimum of 3 years’ experience with mid to large-scale software development projects – understanding all phases of systems development
Strong prioritization and organization skills
Strong presentation and communication skills; excellent listening skills, ability to interface with business customers at all levels of the organization
Strong project management skills
Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent people skills – negotiation, conflict resolution, providing direction and focus
Ability to work on multiple projects at one time with minimal supervision and to ensure that overall priorities are being met
Proven ability to successfully operate within, and contribute to, a high growth, entrepreneurial, fast paced business and matrix environment.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in Air-Time Sales, Business Intelligence, and Audience Research business areas and respective applications desirable
Formal Business Analysis Training desirable
Experience with AI enabled application business design and usage a plus.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Our Empowerment Operations team is looking for a high-performing intern to support one of the most impactful and fast-paced operational strategies in the region. This role is focused on optimizing and scaling key processes that directly support our couriers and shoppers within the DiDi Shop groceries ecosystem across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

You will work closely with experienced operations leaders to ensure efficient execution of prepaid card distribution, delivery of essential supplies, and cross-country coordination of our shopper strategy.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting the end-to-end operational strategy for couriers, including the distribution and activation of prepaid cards and delivery supplies critical for grocery order fulfillment.
Monitoring and optimizing logistics flows for shoppers and couriers across multiple cities and countries.
Collaborating in the design and implementation of regional strategies to improve efficiency and reliability in last-mile operations.
Leading and supporting data coordination efforts to ensure accurate tracking of prepaid card status, inventory of supplies, and shopper coverage.
Conducting benchmarking and best practice analysis related to courier and shopper operations.
Generating data-driven insights to improve execution speed, reduce inefficiencies, and scale our operational capabilities.
Participating in the design and rollout of new initiatives to empower our field teams with the right tools, training, and support to succeed.
Ensuring swift execution with attention to detail, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Enrollment in a bachelor's degree, such as Engineering, Business, or related fields.
Passionate or strongly interested in the Technology.
Analytical and structured with good problem-solving skills.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Collaborative team player with a positive attitude.
Willing to learn and develop his/her skillset; Self-motivated, proactive, with a can-do nature.
High proficiency in both Spanish and English is essential 
Great knowledge of Microsoft Office tools - particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Programming language skills (Python, SQL, or R) are highly appreciated but not required
Availability to work at least 6 hours per day or equivalent to 30 hours per week.
Availability for at least 12 months of contract 



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is a global company that connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. Our drivers and passengers entrust Lyft with their personal information and travel details to get where they are going and expect us to keep that data safe. Lyft's Privacy team is composed of engineers and analysts dedicated to ensuring appropriate data protections are applied to our drivers' and passengers' data. Our goal is to make privacy the default setting for our internal engineers and our customers. We help design architectures, build a scalable data platform, and define policies to reduce the exposure of user data and ensure appropriate privacy and security protections are applied across the company.

We are looking for a highly motivated, collaborative, team-focused and technically strong Senior Software Engineer to join our Privacy team. Every day, you'll partner with engineering, product, legal, and compliance stakeholders on high-impact projects — from building data redaction pipelines to enabling users to exercise their privacy rights to deploying data management systems across a diverse set of Lyft services. You'll bring strong engineering instincts, a passion for privacy, and the ability to lead large projects from idea to execution.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

As Sr. Copywriter for HBO Max, you will be the creative voice of one of the world’s most iconic streaming services. You will be part of Warner Bros. Discovery Mexico’s Creative Services team, working closely with marketing, social, PR and production teams to bring campaigns to life that connect with fans of pop culture, entertainment and premium content.

Write copy that captures HBO Max’s voice and tone: sophisticated, witty, bold, culturally relevant and genuinely connected to the fan.
Collaborate with designers, motion designers and editors to ensure consistency between copy and visual storytelling.
Stay up to date with pop culture trends, social conversations and audience behaviors to identify relevant creative opportunities.
Adapt key messages to different online and offline formats and platforms, including OOH, spots, mentions, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube, understanding the native language of each one.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment with demanding deadlines.
Serve as a creative reference for the team, raising the standard of copy across all pieces.
Work closely with marketing, social and PR teams to ensure message alignment.

Native Spanish with excellent writing skills.

About the job

Spare Parts Specialist




About the Role




Geely Auto Mexico is looking for a Spare Parts Specialist to support the daily operations of our aftersales supply chain and dealer network. This role will be responsible for spare parts order management, billing follow-up, system reconciliation, inventory coordination, catalog maintenance, KPI reporting, and dealer support.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational execution, analytical skills, and stakeholder management capabilities, with experience working across logistics, warehousing, finance, suppliers, and dealership networks in the automotive industry.




Key Responsibilities




Spare Parts Operations & Order Management

Monitor spare parts orders from order placement through invoicing and fulfillment.
Ensure timely and accurate billing of parts orders and direct shipments.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to orders, deliveries, and invoices.
Coordinate closely with Finance and Logistics teams to ensure smooth order processing.




Dealer Credit & Payment Control

Validate advance payments for dealer orders placed under cash-in-advance terms.
Verify payment application before releasing orders for fulfillment.
Monitor dealer floor plan credit utilization and proactively communicate risks or account restrictions.
Coordinate with Finance to resolve credit, payment, and account-related issues.




Systems & Data Management

Monitor data synchronization between SAP, WMS, and internal parts management systems.
Investigate and resolve data discrepancies related to inventory, orders, and transactions.
Coordinate with local and global IT teams on system issues, enhancements, and process improvements.
Maintain master data integrity across systems.




Parts Catalog & Supplier Coordination

Create and maintain part numbers, product classifications, and pricing information.
Ensure catalog accuracy and compliance with invoicing and tax requirements.
Manage purchase orders for local suppliers and follow up on deliveries.
Maintain updated supplier, warehouse, and vendor information.




3PL & Inventory Management

Work closely with third-party logistics providers (3PL) to reconcile inventory and operational data.
Support physical inventory counts and variance analysis.
Participate in warehouse transitions and operational improvement initiatives.




Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Develop and maintain KPI reports related to inventory, lead times, order fulfillment, and billing performance.
Support automation and process improvement projects to increase operational efficiency.
Prepare operational communications, dealer bulletins, and support materials for the dealer network.




Qualifications




Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
2-4 years of experience in Spare Parts, Aftersales, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations within the automotive industry.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
Strong Excel skills and experience creating operational reports and dashboards.
Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders, including dealers, suppliers, warehouses, finance teams, and external partners.
Knowledge of dealership operations and aftersales processes.
Experience with DMS or aftersales systems is a plus.
Intermediate to advanced English communication skills.




Key Competencies

Analytical Thinking
Attention to Detail
Problem Solving
Process Improvement
Operational Excellence
Project Coordination
Effective Communication
Stakeholder Management
Team Collaboration
Customer Focus

title: Mx Program Buyer
skills: Grow and diversify the Mexico supply base to improve competitiveness and optimize cost for purchased components and services.Manage new supplier onboarding and certification, ensuring suppliers meet required eligibility and assessment standards.
Lead sourcing program management activities for Mexico-built vehicles (“Mx to Mx” program management), aligning sourcing timing and deliverables with vehicle program milestones.
Support other buyers and global commodity teams by providing Mexico market intelligence and local supplier options to achieve best-cost outcomes.
New Supplier Identification & Development (Mexico Focus)
Proactively identify, screen, and qualify potential Mexico-based suppliers aligned to commodity strategy and manufacturing footprint needs.
Build and maintain a robust pipeline of candidate suppliers through market research, industry networks, plant/cluster mapping, and collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Engage potential investors/suppliers to develop Mexico commodity capability where gaps exist (localization opportunities, new capacity, or technical capability expansion).
Coordinate supplier discovery activities (intro meetings, RFIs, NDA initiation, capability reviews) and maintain supplier profiles and documentation.
Supplier Eligibility / New Supplier Assessment Leadership
Lead the Supplier Pre-Assessment Process (SPA) to evaluate suitability of supplier manufacturing locations for specific programs and material groups.
Initiate and coordinate New Supplier Assessment requests, ensure required forms/data are complete, and archive/retrieve assessment results per work instruction.

Partner with Supplier Quality and Engineering to ensure assessments cover core quality planning and execution controls (e.g., process control, PFMEA, control plan alignment, containment, escalation, LPA).
Drive closure of assessment findings with suppliers (action plans, timing, follow-up validations), escalating risks as needed.
Coordinate the financial assessment of new suppliers.
Sourcing Execution & Commercial Management
Manage resourcing/sourcing activities from source package creation through execution, including RFQ coordination, supplier communications, and recommendation preparation.
Support negotiations and develop sourcing recommendations consistent with governance and delegation of authority (DoA), partnering with regional/global stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional inputs required for supplier selection (engineering feasibility, capacity, logistics flows, program timing, risk assessments).
Program Management for Mexico Vehicle Production Sourcing
Perform purchasing program management activities for vehicles produced in Mexico by coordinating sourcing deliverables, timing, and readiness gates across multiple commodities and plants.
Track sourcing milestones and ensure supplier industrialization plans align with program requirements (tooling readiness, PPAP timing, launch support).
Provide regular status reporting and risk/issue management to stakeholders (constraints, timing conflicts, open actions).
Cost Competitiveness & Support to Other Buyers
Support other buyers and commodity teams in identifying cost-effective Mexico-based suppliers, including local representation for global teams without Mexico presence.
Contribute to cost reduction initiatives for direct material by identifying localization/resourcing opportunities and supporting implementation with plant and purchasing teams.
Provide Mexico supplier market benchmarks, should-cost inputs (where available), and commercial insights to improve negotiation outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree (Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, or related).
3 years experience in automotive purchasing/sourcing and supplier management (direct materials strongly preferred).
Strong English proficiency (written and spoken).
Proven ability to lead cross-functional workstreams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with quality system expectations used in supplier assessments (e.g., PFMEA/control plan discipline, containment, LPA concepts).
Program management experience supporting vehicle programs or industrialization/launch readiness.

description:
About the job

Job Title: Customer Success Operations Coordinator
Schedule: Part-Time (20 hours/week initially), with the potential to expand based on performance and business needs
Location: Remote (Latin America Preferred)




Overview

Enjoy building strong client relationships while keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes?




Join a growing healthcare cybersecurity company dedicated to helping healthcare organizations strengthen their security posture, protect sensitive data, and navigate today's evolving cybersecurity landscape. As the company continues to expand, they are seeking a Customer Success Operations Coordinator to become the operational backbone of their client success function.




In this role, you'll serve as the primary communication bridge between clients and internal technical teams, ensuring seamless coordination, exceptional client experiences, and long-term relationship success. This opportunity is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys managing multiple stakeholders, communicating with confidence, and keeping projects moving forward. While deep cybersecurity expertise isn't required, an understanding of IT terminology and the ability to communicate technical concepts in client-friendly language will set you up for success.




Key Responsibilities

Organize, schedule, and coordinate Quarterly Business Review (QBR) calls with clients
Ensure meeting participants are prepared and supporting materials are delivered in advance
Serve as the primary point of contact for existing clients, responding to inquiries and coordinating internal follow-up
Facilitate communication between clients and internal technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution
Coordinate crisis communications during security incidents through phone, email, and text
Engage with clients during quarterly reviews to understand their needs and identify opportunities for service expansion and retention
Create, update, and repurpose presentations, pitch decks, and supporting materials for client meetings
Maintain accurate records of client interactions, meeting notes, and follow-up activities
Coordinate communication across internal stakeholders using Microsoft Teams, email, phone, and messaging platforms
Ensure all client communications are professional, timely, and aligned with company standards
Work with the CFO to prepare and send proposals for existing and prospective clients
Maintain accurate client activities, contacts, and records within HubSpot

Must-Have Requirements

3+ years of experience in customer success, operations coordination, account management, executive support, or a similar client-facing role
Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Strong client relationship management and communication abilities
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Experience with or the ability to quickly learn HubSpot CRM, DotLoop, or similar electronic signature solutions
Experience creating professional presentations, reports, and business documents
Ability to manage multiple priorities while coordinating across teams and stakeholders
Comfortable communicating with clients via phone, email, text, and virtual meetings
Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
Reliable internet connection and professional remote work environment

Nice-to-Have Requirements

Familiarity with IT terminology and technology-related environments
Experience using HubSpot CRM
Experience using DotLoop or similar electronic signature platforms
Experience working within the healthcare or cybersecurity industries




Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to become a key member of a growing healthcare cybersecurity company where your work will directly contribute to delivering an outstanding client experience. You'll serve as the central connection between clients and internal teams, helping ensure every interaction is organized, responsive, and professional while supporting meaningful, long-term client relationships.




As the company continues to grow, you'll have the opportunity to expand your responsibilities, collaborate closely with leadership, and make a visible impact on customer success operations. If you enjoy building relationships, coordinating moving pieces, and creating exceptional client experiences in a fast-paced environment, this role offers the chance to grow your career while contributing to a mission-driven organization dedicated to protecting healthcare organizations and the communities they serve.

About the job

Description

Amazon is looking for a talented, smart, experienced and enthusiastic Marketing Manager to help develop and grow our Category marketing business in Mexico. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting new team structure.

The successful candidate will develop strategies and managing the execution of acquisition, engagement and retention initiatives, primarily via online channels including push notifications, emails, onsite experience, SEO, internal search, affiliate marketing, social media and mobile.

Candidate is expected to improve key product features (Search, IDQ, Personalization, Fit, Detail Page, RCX...) by working cross-functionally across Emerging marketplaces stakeholders. You will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Main KPIs are: traffic, acquisition, customer active base, settlement and lapsed rates. Responsibilities:


 Lead site merchandising for all categories across MX - develop and execute merchandising activities, manage navigation structure, create pages and merchandising features to support coop initiatives, coordinate and support promotional events and marketing campaigns.
 Lead several programs for customer acquisition and engagement, partnering with several tech teams
 Work closely with the traffic teams to drive customers and sales to our store, including gateway, outbound, associates, search, social media.
 Design, lead and implement customer experience enhancement/improvement projects.
 Create and analyze performance metrics and making business decisions about future direction based on performance and ROI
 Partner with various technical and business teams to build supporting automation
 Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting of key content and marketing metrics to the leadership team and broader organization.


The ideal candidate will be innovative, team oriented, an effective communicator across functions and levels, have a desire to participate in change, and appreciate a highly entrepreneurial environment with rapidly changing priorities. We are seeking someone with proven track record in project and stakeholder management, deep analytical skills, and ability to simplify and scale.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
 Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
 Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
About the job

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

México was Tilt’s first market outside the US. Launched in 2022, we’ve already helped thousands of customers access fair credit in moments of need — using alternative data and technology to serve those often overlooked by traditional lenders. We’re scaling rapidly and preparing to launch new products that will expand our reach and deepen our impact across the country.

The Opportunity: Performance Marketing Manager

We are seeking a Performance Marketing Manager to scale our mobile acquisition engine in Mexico. We've already built a live, growing business - and we're investing significantly to accelerate it. This role is responsible for deploying, measuring, and optimizing a multimillion-dollar advertising budget across channels such as Meta, Google App Campaigns, and DSPs.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and execution. You will operate as both a hands-on media buyer and a highly analytical problem solver, owning performance end-to-end, from campaign setup to deep funnel optimization.

As the first dedicated performance marketing hire on Mexico, you'll partner with our existing agency while progressively bringing knowledge and capabilities in-house - with real traction already behind you and a mandate to push it much further.

This is a remote role with a preference for individuals based in México or in a similar time zone. Occasional travel will be required for company onsites and market visits (minimum 4-6 times per year).

How You'll Make An Impact


Own paid acquisition end-to-end across mobile channels (Meta, Google App Campaigns, DSPs, and others), including campaign setup, optimization, and scaling.
Own and mature the performance marketing function - building out processes, reporting, and experimentation frameworks on top of an already-live, scaling business.
Manage and develop our agency relationship, extracting knowledge, building internal capabilities, and progressively owning more of the execution in-house.
Optimize for full-funnel performance, from impression to repayment behavior - improving CAC, conversion rates, and LTV.
Design and run rigorous experiments (A/B tests, incrementality tests, creative testing) to continuously improve performance, even in low-signal environments.
Allocate and optimize budget dynamically based on performance, risk, and business priorities.
Drive creative strategy and iteration, translating performance data into actionable insights on messaging, formats, and audiences.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Risk, Analytics, and Design to improve targeting, onboarding flows, and conversion.
Own mobile attribution and measurement, working with tools like AppsFlyer/Adjust and navigating signal loss (e.g., SKAN, privacy changes).
Develop deep expertise in the Mexico market - including channel dynamics, user behavior, payment patterns, and regulatory considerations - and use it to inform strategy.


Why You're a Great Fit


5–7 years of hands-on experience in mobile performance marketing, with ownership of campaign performance.
Proven track record managing and scaling app acquisition campaigns on platforms like Meta, Google App Campaigns, or DSPs.
Experience optimizing beyond installs, using downstream metrics (e.g., activation, conversion, revenue, LTV) to drive decisions.
Familiarity with mobile attribution tools (e.g., AppsFlyer) and challenges related to signal loss (e.g., SKAN).
Strong analytical skills; ability to connect marketing performance to business outcomes (CAC, LTV, payback).
Experience working with SQL to analyze performance and generate insights independently.
High level of ownership and comfort with ambiguity - able to build structure and drive results in a fast-scaling environment.
Strong communication skills; able to influence cross-functional stakeholders with data.
Fluency in Spanish and English


Nice to Have


Experience in FinTech, lending, or credit-focused businesses
Experience in Mexico or other emerging markets
Experience with incrementality testing
Familiarity with creative strategy at scale (UGC, iteration frameworks)
Experience with DSPs and programmatic buying
Experience optimizing for down-funnel outcomes such as approvals and repayment behavior


Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt


Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Formamos parte del universo Cuatroochenta, un grupo tecnológico internacional formado por distintas compañías especializadas en soluciones cloud y ciberseguridad. Cada empresa del grupo tiene su propia personalidad, pero compartimos algo en común: desarrollar tecnología que funcione de verdad y que esté al servicio de las personas y de las organizaciones (y si además esa tecnología es útil y no explota, mucho mejor).




Además, desde 2020 Cuatroochenta cotiza en BME Growth, reforzando su compromiso con la transparencia y el crecimiento sostenible.




En Cuatroochenta somos más de 350 profesionales con presencia en 12 ciudades en España (Castelló -sede central-, Barcelona, Madrid, Málaga, Lugo, Burgos y València) y Latinoamérica (Panamá, Bogotá, San José, Santo Domingo y Ciudad de México).




💪¿Cuál será tu misión?

Como Marketing Manager, tu misión principal será se la intervención principal entre cliente y empresa, transformar necesidades del cliente en oportunidades de

negocio y comprender los objetivos del cliente, gestionar y coordinar la puesta en marcha para la consecución de estos.




💪Entre tus funciones se incluirán:




Gestión de eventos
Planificación y organización de eventos
Coordinación con proveedores
Definición de presupuesto y control de costes
Coordinación del equipo
Diseño y ejecución de campañas digitales
Definición de buyer personas y segmentación de audiencias
Optimización de CPC/CPL/ROAS y creación de calendario de contenidos
Coordinación con otros equipos multidisciplinares
Análisis de métricas y ajuste de estrategia
Diseño y encargo de material promocional
Gestión de stock y proveedores
Distribución en eventos, oficinas o como parte de campañas de fidelización
Supervisión de contenido, actualización y mantenimiento del sitio web
Optimización SEO on-page y estrategia de contenidos
A/B testing de landing pages
Gestión y segmentación de la base de datos de clientes/leads
Diseño de flujos de automatización
Alineación con ventas para el seguimiento del funnel
Reporting de KPIs de marketing y su impacto en pipeline
Definición de estrategias de marketing para asegurar el cumplimiento de procedimientos
Realizar presupuesto anual y reporting a la dirección




🌟 Lo que necesitamos para esta misión

+5 años de experiencia en Marketing.
Formación en Marketing, ADE, Publicidad y Relaciones Públicas o similar; valorable Máster en Dirección de Marketing o Digital Business.
Se valorará experiencia en sectores B2B o TIC, gestión de presupuestos de marketing, herramientas de automatización (HubSpot, Marketo) y analítica web (GA4, Looker Studio).
Se valorará experiencia en Zoho, WordPress, Campaings... Así como, conocimiento de diseño en canva o ppt.
Habilidades clave: orientación al cliente, capacidad de análisis, comunicación, metodología, orden, resolución de problemas y trabajo en equipo.
Disponibilidad para viajar.




Buscamos personas con voz propia: que propongan, decidan y tengan iniciativa. Aquí tus ideas no se quedan en órbita, se ponen en marcha.




🚀 Por qué merece la pena subir a esta nave

Somos un grupo tecnológico con una cultura basada en la transparencia, la confianza y la colaboración. Un lugar donde la tecnología tiene un propósito claro y las personas están en el centro.




Crecemos como equipo, compartimos rumbo y damos espacio para que cada persona tenga voz, impacto y autonomía en su trabajo. Y no solo te lo decimos nosotros, contamos con la certificación Great Place to Work desde 2020 y el último año seleccionada entre las Best Workplaces Tech España.




Horario flexible.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrido.
Plan de retribución flexible (seguro de salud, cheque restaurante, transporte, guardería, formación).
Formación continua a través del plan formativo anual (Certificaciones, cursos, tech talks internas y jornadas de team building).
Acceso a plataformas de e-learning (Udemy, Codely, Coursera y Zoho Learn).
Acceso al Club de descuentos “Por ser Cuatroochenter” para el trabajador y 5 familiares y/o amigos.
Acceso a las 480coins.
Retribución competitiva: salario fijo + variable vinculado a tu plan de carrera y según valía.




Trabajamos con objetivos claros, confianza y espacio para proponer y crecer, dentro de una compañía que sigue expandiéndose sin perder su esencia.

About the job

About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves. Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what's next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Instagram | TikTok | Culture page

Role Mission

Manage day-to-day social media activity with a strong focus on community engagement and real-time conversations.

It requires a deep understanding of online audience behavior and the ability to translate it into relevant and authentic content. A strong connection to digital culture and experience engaging with diverse communities, including LGBTQ+ audiences, is essential to ensure respectful and effective communication.

,

Key Responsibilities


Manage the day-to-day social media presence.
Plan and update the content calendar.
Create and publish brand-aligned content.
Monitor relevant trends and conversations.
Engage with the audience (comments and messages).
Identify real-time engagement opportunities.
Escalate sensitive topics with sound judgment.
Collaborate with internal teams (creative, strategy, media).
Support paid media amplification.
Analyze performance and optimize the strategy.


Skills & Experience


2+ years of experience in social media management and/or community management
Previous experience working in agencies or fast-paced environments
Strong writing skills and ability to adapt tone depending on context, audience, and platform
Deep understanding of internet culture, platform behaviors, and online communities
Experience managing conversations in real time, including sensitive or high-context topics Ability to identify trends early and act quickly without losing brand consistency Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple workstreams


Benefits


Work your way — Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters — Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us — Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey — Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.
Remote Role
Location: Mexico


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder? Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We're not looking for people who think the same, we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we'll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

Company Description

About Us

Fortune Brands began its journey as a publicly traded company (NYSE: FBHS or “Fortune Brands Home & Security, Inc.”) in 2011, as a successful spin-off from Fortune Brands, Inc. Since then, we have grown organically and through acquisitions, and have delivered strong financial performance. We have also proven our resilience and execution excellence. We outperformed and expanded in our categories through the housing market recovery, and executed our strategies through global disruptions, while refining our portfolio for the future.

On December 14, 2022, we completed the separation of our Cabinets business, enabling us to pursue our unique and exciting path for accelerating growth and productivity.

Today, we are a new company: Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. (NYSE: FBIN). We are focused on driving our brand, innovation and channel leadership, and winning in supercharged categories.

Why work with us?

Responsible for coordinating, implementing and monitoring the in‑store displays plan for Wholesale and Retail sales channels. Coordinate the execution of the display plan at points of sale, ensuring alignment with marketing and commercial goals.
Monitor the implementation of display initiatives in Wholesale and Retail sales channels.
Supervise and audit in‑store displays and POP materials to ensure adherence to brand guidelines and quality standards.
Identify areas for improvement in execution and propose corrective or optimization actions.
Generate reports on key metrics.

Minimum of 3 years of marketing experience is required

High attention to detail
Effective communication skills with internal teams and external partners
Time flexibility

About the job

About PayJoy

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

This role

As the Credit Line Growth Analyst, you will drive sales performance by bridging training, content creation, and data analytics. In this role, you will own the end-to-end enablement process—designing and delivering impactful training programs, collaborating across PayJoy departments, and analyzing sales performance data to turn complex insights into actionable growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities


Sales Enablement & Content Design: Design and deliver training, onboarding, tools, and collateral for internal teams, partners, and store advisors. 
Commercial Productivity: Collaborate with sales teams to identify knowledge gaps among clients and staff. 
Commercial Support & Issue Resolution: Channel commercial needs to the corresponding areas (operations, product, support, training) and follow up on incidents. 
Commercial Feedback: Maintain a structured feedback channel, documenting field findings, prioritizing inputs, and proposing improvements to recurring friction points. 
Data Analytics & Reporting: Analyze sales data at scale (KPIs, KBIs, KKIs, KSIs), measure the ROI of initiatives and promotions, and present clear, actionable reports for decision-makers. 


Qualifications


Associate's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing.

High capacity for organization, communication, and relationships

Ability to adapt quickly to changes in the work environment and priorities; and to adapt to learn new processes, concepts, and skills.

description:
About the job

About the Company:

Wayfinder Agency is the #1 digital marketing agency for tabletop game companies, a fully remote team of marketers, media buyers, and creatives who help incredible games reach players around the world. Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. We’re not your typical agency: we move fast, think creatively, and care deeply about performance. We operate with a lean, collaborative culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership, and if you love strategy, data, and working with passionate creative teams, you’ll fit right in. 




About the Role:

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Designer & Team Lead who will personally produce high-performing static and motion ads for paid digital campaigns every week, while also mentoring and developing a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers. This role is both a working creative seat and a leadership seat: you’ll build the templates, best practices, and workflows the team runs on, stay close to real performance data, and help define how creative gets made at a growing agency. A genuine passion for tabletop games and gaming culture is a major plus.




This role is a Full-Time remote position.




We are looking for a Senior Designer & Team Lead specifically with these requirements:

Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.




Nice to Haves:

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.




Growth Opportunities/Perks:

Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.




You’re a Great Fit for This Role If…

 ✅ You know what high-performing paid social creative looks like and can produce it yourself.

 ✅ You care about measurable outcomes such as CTR, conversions, and ROAS-not just visual quality.

 ✅ You work quickly, stay organized, and can turn limited client-provided assets into effective ads.

 ✅ You enjoy mentoring designers, giving clear feedback, and helping a creative team improve.

 ✅ You communicate proactively and thrive in a fast-moving, remote agency environment.




Our hiring process is made up of four parts, so please be aware that you will need to dedicate time for a questionnaire, a video, and two 1-on-1 interviews.




Thank you for taking the time to consider this position. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

title: Multimedia Designer/AI Artist
description:
About the job

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About The Role

Monks is seeking a visionary AI Specialist to join our specialized team. We manage a complex product account requiring expertise far beyond typical social media marketing. This is a hybrid role demanding both technical proficiency and creative strategy.

You will be the bridge between cutting-edge AI developments and engaging social content. Your focus will be on anticipating the future of LLM’s by exploring the current AI landscape, utilizing APIs and coding knowledge to experiment and prototype. Your work will not only keep our social channels ahead of the curve but will also educate our internal teams and our external audience of AI enthusiasts.

Responsibilities

Technical Foresight & Landscape Analysis. Actively monitor developments from Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic to anticipate upcoming AI features. Maintain deep knowledge of the broader AI landscape to provide strategic insights.

Advanced Content Creation & Prototyping. Create compelling social content for X and Instagram targeted at AI enthusiasts. Design and execute complex prompts and utilize API’s to prototype internal tools, test new capabilities, and produce unique images, videos, and copy.

Internal Training & Enablement. Serve as the go-to AI expert, bridging the knowledge gap within the organization. Develop and lead training sessions for creative, strategy, and design teams on new and upcoming AI features.

Playbook Development & Documentation. Document internal use cases and build comprehensive playbooks on how to integrate AI tools (including the Google Work Suite) effectively across the company's strategy, creative, and operations departments.

Education & Demystification. Be a key part of our strategy to demystify AI. For external content, break down the prompts and the technical details (including API usage when relevant) in an engaging, easy-to-understand way.

Client-Facing Engagement. You may also be called upon to engage directly with clients, leveraging your AI expertise to collaboratively problem-solve and educate them on efficient prompting techniques, ensuring they can maximize the utility of AI tools.

About You

Technical Proficiency (Required): Proven experience in coding and hands-on proficiency in working with AI/ML APIs. You must be comfortable exploring technical documentation and building or testing tools.

A Master of Prompts & AI Ecosystems: A proven ability to get extraordinary results from generative AI tools. You must be "in the weeds" with current LLM’s.

A Natural Trainer and Explainer: Excellent at translating complex, technical concepts into simple, engaging language. You must have a passion for training others and documenting processes.

Social Savvy (Niche Expertise): Deep understanding of what resonates with the AI enthusiast community on platforms like X, and the ability to advise copywriters on relevant technical trends.

A Creative Problem-Solver: You love a challenge and enjoy figuring out how to use new technology, including APIs, to solve creative problems, build internal tools, and optimize workflows.

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

 TS1

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

description:
About the job

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What You’ll Do


Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.
Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.
Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.
Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.
Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.
Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.
Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.


What You’ll Need


Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.
A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.
Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.
Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.
The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.
A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.


This Role Isn’t For Everyone

You should probably pass if:


You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.
You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.
You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.
You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.


Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:


Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.
Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.
Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.
Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support
Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth
The technology and tools you need to do your best work 
Motivosity employee recognition program
A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection


We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

This role will be part of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Team within the Financial Crimes organization in SDC that is accountable for monitoring, investigating, and reporting suspicious activity indicative of money laundering and other financial crimes.

What you’ll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about financial crimes and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for reviewing and dispositioning Transaction Monitoring alerts, conducting AML Investigations, and drafting and filing Suspicious Activity reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Report (STRs) with various Financial Intelligence Units.

Responsibilities


Conduct AML Investigations from beginning to end, including conducting transaction analysis and open-source and public records research in various jurisdictions.
Document in detail the rationale for the investigative process and recommendations of each review.
Draft and file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with various Financial Intelligence Units.
Maintain operational excellence across various workstreams.
Review and disposition Transaction Monitoring alerts.
Demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to navigate non-binary, high-risk decisions.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Strong English written and verbal capabilities;
2+ years of analytical or investigative experience, preferably within the financial crimes, AML, risk, threat analysis, or fraud fields.
Strong research, writing, and analytical skills.
Ability to demonstrate an understanding of financial crime typologies and patterns utilized to exploit financial institutions.
Ability to synthesize large amounts of information such as transaction data and identify key trends. 
Ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case.



Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge and experience in the payments and fintech industry.
Previous experience working in a Compliance function.
ACAMS or similar certification.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
